assumptions: Base3/2 digit representation and branch/observable spaces exactly as specified in companion audit.
map_clock: f(x)=floor(3x/2), x0=8; budget b0=0, +2 on even inputs and -1 on odd inputs. Driver updates are not native TM steps. y=x-1, yprime=ceil3y/2; Ncountsdriverupdates.
proof_summary: Each appended parity digit increases digit sum by even-input indicator, giving budget identity. Direct composition with sign-weighted pullback gives BS=I. Population average and one fixed sparse path have different quantifiers.
attribution: Project fixed-branch transfer audit; external rational-base distribution and normality authors credited as context, not solvers of Antihydra.
novelty: Exact scope/transfer diagnosis; historical novelty not established.
limitations: External papers not fully re-audited. Even limiting parity1/2 would need effective prefix control. All-source normality cited is conjectural.
significance: Blocks a specific misapplication of population statistics to fixed-orbit safety.

title: Antihydra fixed-source all-prefix safety remains open
statement: Unknown whether every prefix of f-orbit from8 has O_t<=2t/3, equivalently whether native blank Antihydra never halts.
assumptions: Exact source8, budget0, actual native halt convention; not a larger-source asymptotic.
map_clock: f(x)=floor(3x/2), x0=8; budget b0=0, +2 on even inputs and -1 on odd inputs. Driver updates are not native TM steps.
proof_summary: Exact equivalences AH01/AH06 identify target; no closed source-derived invariant, global exclusion theorem or authenticated failure found by latest checkpoint. External official page still describes open status.
attribution: External open problem; project contributes partial structure and estimates.
novelty: No claim of solution.
limitations: Finite survival, positive drift heuristics, effective growing-source funding, and equivalent reformulations do not discharge universal fixed-source quantifier.
significance: Central boundary every pre-paper conclusion must retain.

title: Independent review regression suite
statement: All bounded independent tests in antihydra_independent_checks.json passed:10000phase/run,1022words/twolifts,175unsafe families,64honestprefixes,20rationalshadows,128championreturns,531nativeAntihydracases,finite controls.
assumptions: Ranges explicitly recorded; checker written fresh without importing archived project scripts.
map_clock: Each test explicitly distinguishes driver, phase, run and native clocks.
proof_summary: Literal tape simulator independently compares native endpoints and exact steps; integer arithmetic checks formulas and source-authenticated examples.
attribution: New2026-10-21 pre-paper review computation, not original research inventory rerun.
novelty: Independent regression evidence only.
limitations: No infinite proof, no exhaustive7056 rerun, no Coq build. Counts are bounded cases, not confidence probabilities.
significance: Adds reproducible indexing/clock/algebra checks independent of supplied implementations.

title: Earlier fixed-run funding via S-units
statement: For each fixed numberR of maximal constant-cost runs in honest source family, total formal driver length K_R(t)=o(t); costs and repetitions need not be bounded.
assumptions: FixedR while t grows; finite exceptional source parameters possible and ineffective in this argument.
map_clock: f(x)=floor(3x/2), x0=8; budget b0=0, +2 on even inputs and -1 on odd inputs. Driver updates are not native TM steps.
proof_summary: Compress runs into <=(R+2)2^R labelled S-unit terms with exactlytwo odd terms. Nondegenerate finite S-unit solution theorem bounds exceptional zero subsums involving odd terms; remove all-even cancellations and apply lower bound. Later AH13 supersedes with effective polylog bound.
